headline: Held discussion of Public Services Committee Priorities until February 23rd meeting.
summary: The committee reviewed plans for discussing Order #040, Public Services Committee Priorities, using sticky notes to identify top issues. The committee voted to hold the matter until a meeting on Monday, February 23rd at 6:30pm.
decisions: Held Order #40 until a meeting on Monday, February 23rd at 6:30pm, 2-0.
